svg.title: AspirantOS - ER diagram (MySQL database aspirantos)
svg.text: 26 tables · 34 foreign keys · database aspirantos (MySQL 8.4, InnoDB)
PK = primary key · FK = foreign key · UK = unique key · bar = one, crow's foot = many
Line colour = parent table: blue → app_user, orange → exam, purple → exam_rule_version, grey → others. Views, procedures and triggers are listed in docs/DB_DESIGN.md.
